Yes.

Rules: because the Suddenly Reversed Giant's Blood was never played.

still there to be discovered by your minion.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
"Chris Barnhart [Mr. Pynk]" <tvba...@server.wulaw.wustl.edu> writes:
>> If my opponent plays Giant's Blood and i Sudden Reversal it, can i
>> play my Giant's Blood later on in the same game???

>Yes.

No.

>Rules: because the Suddenly Reversed Giant's Blood was never played.

Rules: SR only cancels a master card as it is being played. Therefore,
it must be "played" to be SR'ed, and any subsequent time that Giant's Blood
is "played", it will have no effect (card text).

This has been the official ruling since 9/23/94.

>Concept: His minion never found the unique vial of Giant's Blood, so it's
>still there to be discovered by your minion.

Nolo contendre.

This may be another thing that changed betwen Jyhad and V:Tes, but on the
Jyhad version, the card says "If this is the first timeGiant's blood is
played, refil the target vamp to capacity. If Giant's blood has already
been played, the card has no effect."

In other words, in Jyhad at least, you could play the card if it had
already been played, but it wouldn't do anything for you. If it had been
sudden Reversaled, it had still been played, and would therefore have no
effect.

Basically, this menas that you'd only want to play the card the second
time to help loosen card jam.

Joe

Joe's right. Sudden Reversal cancels the card (both effect and cost), but
does not undo the fact that the card was played.

This has been explicitly stated in many Rules Team Rulings since Nov94.
